title: EUROPA Alignment: A Transparent, Parallel Safety Benchmark for 36 European Languages
description: Technical report, code, benchmark items and run artifacts for EUROPA Alignment, an open multilingual AI-safety benchmark that applies 16 original safety scenarios to each of the 36 languages prioritized by OpenEuroLLM (576 items), with paired harmful/benign contrasts, critical-dimension score gates and a pinned independent LLM judge. The report evaluates four SFT and DPO checkpoints of a 9B OpenEuroLLM model. The PDF is in paper/europa-alignment.pdf.
